OBJECTIVE.TITLE: Objective
OBJECTIVE.BODY: Win the game by taking all your Prize cards or leaving your opponent with no Pokémon in play. Each player starts with 6 Prize cards face-down; every time you knock out an opponent's Pokémon, you take 1 (or 2 for Pokémon-EX). The first player to take all their Prize cards wins.

SETUP.TITLE: Setup
SETUP.BODY: Each player shuffles their 60-card deck and draws 7. If you have no Basic Pokémon in hand, reveal your hand, shuffle it back, and draw 7 new cards (mulligan): your opponent draws 1 extra card for each mulligan you take. Then place 1 Basic Pokémon as your Active and up to 5 more on the Bench, all face-down. Set aside 6 Prize cards and flip a coin to decide who goes first.

TURN.TITLE: Turn Structure
TURN.DRAW_BODY: Draw 1 card from your deck. If your deck is empty when you try to draw, you lose.
TURN.MAIN_BODY: You may take these actions in any order as many times as valid: place Basic Pokémon on your Bench, evolve Pokémon (not the same turn you played them), attach 1 Energy card to any of your Pokémon, play Trainer cards, retreat once per turn, and use Abilities.
TURN.ATTACK_BODY: You may attack once with your Active Pokémon. Attacking is optional but ends your turn immediately. The player who goes first cannot attack on their first turn.

TRAINERS.TITLE: Trainer Cards
TRAINERS.INTRO: Trainer cards come in four types, each played differently:
TRAINERS.ITEM_BODY: No limit per turn. Immediate effect; the card is discarded after use.
TRAINERS.SUPPORTER_BODY: Only 1 per turn. Immediate effect; the card is discarded after use.
TRAINERS.STADIUM_BODY: Stays in play in the shared zone. Only 1 Stadium can be active at a time; playing a new one discards the previous one.
TRAINERS.TOOL_BODY: Attaches to one of your Pokémon. Maximum 1 Tool per Pokémon. It stays attached until the Pokémon leaves play, at which point it is discarded along with the Pokémon.

CONDITIONS.TITLE: Special Conditions
CONDITIONS.INTRO: Only the Active Pokémon can have conditions. They are removed when it retreats, evolves, or is replaced.
CONDITIONS.ASLEEP_BODY: Cannot attack or retreat. Between turns: flip a coin. Heads = wakes up; Tails = stays asleep.
CONDITIONS.BURNED_BODY: Between turns: flip a coin. Tails = takes 20 damage; Heads = no damage.
CONDITIONS.CONFUSED_BODY: When trying to attack: flip a coin. Tails = the attack fails and the Pokémon deals 30 damage to itself.
CONDITIONS.PARALYZED_BODY: Cannot attack or retreat. Automatically healed at the end of the player's next full turn.
CONDITIONS.POISONED_BODY: Automatically takes 10 damage between turns. No coin flip required.

VICTORY.TITLE: Winning and Losing
VICTORY.PRIZES_BODY: The first player to take their last Prize card wins.
VICTORY.KNOCKOUT_BODY: If you knock out the opponent's Active Pokémon and they have no Pokémon on the Bench to replace it, you win.
VICTORY.DECK_BODY: If you try to draw at the start of your turn and your deck is empty, you lose.

HELP_BUTTON.TITLE: Tutorial

WELCOME.TITLE: Professor Oak
WELCOME.DESCRIPTION: Welcome! I'm Professor Oak, and I'll guide you through this page step by step.

NAVBAR.TITLE: Main navigation
NAVBAR.DESCRIPTION: This is the main navigation bar. From here, you can move between Home, Deck, and Pokédex.

HOME.TITLE: Home
HOME.DESCRIPTION: You are on the Home page. This is where you check your status and prepare before starting a match.

DECK_NAV.TITLE: Deck
DECK_NAV.DESCRIPTION: The Deck section lets you create, review, or choose a valid deck. You need one before playing.

POKEDEX.TITLE: Pokédex
POKEDEX.DESCRIPTION: The Pokédex lets you browse cards, types, and attacks before building your strategy.

LANGUAGE.TITLE: Language
LANGUAGE.DESCRIPTION: Use this button to switch the interface between Spanish and English. The tutorial follows your current language.

USER_STATUS.TITLE: User status
USER_STATUS.DESCRIPTION: Here you can see your user and account status. You still need a valid deck before playing.

MAIN_PANEL.TITLE: Main panel
MAIN_PANEL.DESCRIPTION: This is your main control area. Choose a deck here and start a match when everything is ready.

INVALID_DECK.TITLE: Active deck
INVALID_DECK.DESCRIPTION: This status shows whether your active deck is ready. If it is invalid, choose or prepare a valid one first.

CHOOSE_DECK.TITLE: Choose or create a deck
CHOOSE_DECK.DESCRIPTION: Choose an existing deck with this button, or select Deck in the navigation bar to create and edit one.

SEARCH_MATCH.TITLE: Find a match
SEARCH_MATCH.DESCRIPTION: Once your deck is valid, use this button to search for an opponent and start a match.

CUSTOM_MATCH.TITLE: Custom match
CUSTOM_MATCH.DESCRIPTION: Custom match lets you choose a more specific setup for playing with friends or practicing.

HOW_TO_PLAY.TITLE: How to play
HOW_TO_PLAY.DESCRIPTION: This panel gives you a quick summary of the most important rules.

OBJECTIVE.TITLE: Objective
OBJECTIVE.DESCRIPTION: Win by taking all your Prize cards or leaving your opponent without Pokémon in play.

TURN.TITLE: Turn
TURN.DESCRIPTION: Draw a card, take your main actions, and then attack with your Active Pokémon.

CONDITIONS.TITLE: Special conditions
CONDITIONS.DESCRIPTION: Asleep, Paralyzed, Confused, Poisoned, and Burned can change your strategy during a match.

MANUAL.TITLE: Manual
MANUAL.DESCRIPTION: Use the Manual button to review the rules in more detail before playing.

FINISH.TITLE: Ready to play
FINISH.DESCRIPTION: Choose or create a valid deck first, then find a match and start playing.

WELCOME.TITLE: Decks
WELCOME.DESCRIPTION: Welcome to the deck section. Here you can prepare the deck you will use to play matches.

SLOTS.TITLE: Deck slots
SLOTS.DESCRIPTION: You can save up to 3 decks. Each slot is an available space to create or manage a deck.

CREATE_FROM_EMPTY.TITLE: Create deck
CREATE_FROM_EMPTY.DESCRIPTION: This slot is empty. Click anywhere inside the card or the plus button to start creating a new deck.

NAME.TITLE: Deck name
NAME.DESCRIPTION: First, choose a name for your deck. This name will appear later in your saved deck list.

RANDOM.TITLE: Randomize
RANDOM.DESCRIPTION: If this is your first time or you want to build something quickly, use Random. The system will automatically create a valid deck.

CLEAR.TITLE: Clear
CLEAR.DESCRIPTION: Clear removes all selected cards from the current deck. It is useful when you want to start over without leaving this screen.

SAVE.TITLE: Save
SAVE.DESCRIPTION: When your deck has 60 cards and follows the rules, you can save it from this button.

CARDS.TITLE: Available cards
CARDS.DESCRIPTION: Here you can see all available cards to build your deck. You can choose Pokémon, Energy and Trainer cards.

SEARCH.TITLE: Search cards
SEARCH.DESCRIPTION: Use the search input to find a card by name. It is useful when you already know which card you want to add.

FILTERS.TITLE: Filters
FILTERS.DESCRIPTION: These filters let you see all cards or separate them by Pokémon, Energy and Trainer.

ADD_CARD.TITLE: Add cards
ADD_CARD.DESCRIPTION: Click a card to add it to your deck. You can also manage the quantity from the list on the right.

DECK_PANEL.TITLE: Deck panel
DECK_PANEL.DESCRIPTION: On the right you can see the deck you are building, including selected cards and the total amount.

COUNTER.TITLE: Card count
COUNTER.DESCRIPTION: This counter shows how many cards you have added. To save, your deck must reach 60 out of 60 cards.

RULES.TITLE: Deck rules
RULES.DESCRIPTION: These rules tell you whether your deck is valid. You need to meet them before saving.

SELECTED_CARDS.TITLE: Selected cards
SELECTED_CARDS.DESCRIPTION: This list shows the cards that are already part of the deck. Each row shows the card, its name and how many copies you added.

QUANTITY_BUTTONS.TITLE: Add or remove copies
QUANTITY_BUTTONS.DESCRIPTION: Use + to add one more copy and - to remove one. The indicator in the middle shows how many copies you currently have.

TYPE_HIGHLIGHT.TITLE: Card types
TYPE_HIGHLIGHT.DESCRIPTION: Cards have a visual highlight to help you identify whether they are Pokémon, Energy or Trainer cards.

BACK.TITLE: Back
BACK.DESCRIPTION: Use Back to return to your deck slots. If you already saved your deck, you will see it in its slot.

ACTIVE_DECK.TITLE: Active deck
ACTIVE_DECK.DESCRIPTION: This banner shows which deck is currently active. That is the deck used when you start a match.

DECK_CARD.TITLE: Saved deck
DECK_CARD.DESCRIPTION: This is one of your saved decks. Here you can see its name and a summary of Pokémon, Energy and Trainer cards.

EDIT.TITLE: Edit
EDIT.DESCRIPTION: Edit takes you to a screen where all the cards from this deck are loaded so you can modify it.

ACTIVATE.TITLE: Activate
ACTIVATE.DESCRIPTION: Activate marks this deck as your main deck. The active deck is the one you will use to play.

ACTIVATE_ACTIVE.DESCRIPTION: This deck is already active. When a deck is active, it is the one you will use to play matches.

DELETE.TITLE: Delete
DELETE.DESCRIPTION: Delete removes this saved deck. Use it only if you are sure, because you will lose that setup.

DECK_CARDS.TITLE: Deck cards
DECK_CARDS.DESCRIPTION: Below you can see the cards from the active deck with the exact number of copies for each one.

POKEDEX.TITLE: View in Pokédex
POKEDEX.DESCRIPTION: If you click a card from the deck, you will be redirected to the Pokédex to see more details.

OPEN_EDIT.TITLE: Open edit screen
OPEN_EDIT.DESCRIPTION: Now click Edit to open the edit screen and continue the tutorial from there.

WELCOME.TITLE: Edit deck
WELCOME.DESCRIPTION: This is the edit screen. The current cards from your deck are loaded here so you can modify them.

LOADED_CARDS.TITLE: Loaded cards
LOADED_CARDS.DESCRIPTION: On the right you can already see the cards that belong to the deck. You can add or remove copies using the + and - buttons.

MODIFY_QUANTITY.TITLE: Modify quantities
MODIFY_QUANTITY.DESCRIPTION: Use + to add copies and - to remove them. The counter in the middle shows the current amount for that card.

SAVE_CHANGES.TITLE: Save changes
SAVE_CHANGES.DESCRIPTION: When you finish editing and the deck still follows the rules, save your changes from this button.

WELCOME.TITLE: Deck area
WELCOME.DESCRIPTION: Welcome to the deck area. This is where you prepare your deck before jumping into a match.

SLOTS.TITLE: Empty deck slots
SLOTS.DESCRIPTION: These empty slots are your deck spaces. You can have up to 3 decks. Click any empty slot to create a new one.

ACTIVE_DECK.TITLE: Active deck
ACTIVE_DECK.DESCRIPTION: This banner shows your active deck. That is the deck used when you start a match.

DECK_CARD.TITLE: Deck card
DECK_CARD.DESCRIPTION: This deck card shows the deck name and a summary of its Pokemon, Energy, and Trainer cards.

STATS.TITLE: Card summary
STATS.DESCRIPTION: These numbers show how many Pokemon, Energy, and Trainer cards are in the deck.

EDIT.TITLE: Edit
EDIT.DESCRIPTION: You have two options: click Edit to continue the tutorial in the deck editor, or press Continue to stay here and review the active deck cards.

ACTIVATE.TITLE: Activate
ACTIVATE.DESCRIPTION: Activate sets this as your main deck. If you have multiple decks, this chooses the one used for matches.

ACTIVATE_ACTIVE.DESCRIPTION: This deck is already active, so it is the one that will be used in matches.

DELETE.TITLE: Delete
DELETE.DESCRIPTION: Delete removes the deck. Use it carefully.

ACTIVE_CARDS.TITLE: Active deck cards
ACTIVE_CARDS.DESCRIPTION: Here you can see the exact cards in the active deck, including the number of copies of each one.

POKEDEX.TITLE: Open in Pokedex
POKEDEX.DESCRIPTION: Click a card in the lower panel to open its details in the Pokedex.

FINISH.TITLE: Done
FINISH.DESCRIPTION: Done. You now know how to create, edit, activate, delete, and review decks. Time to play.

WELCOME.TITLE: Deck editor
WELCOME.DESCRIPTION: You are now in the editor. Your current deck cards are loaded here so you can modify the deck without starting from scratch.

NAME.TITLE: Deck name
NAME.DESCRIPTION: First, choose a deck name. This name will identify the deck when you activate it and use it in a match.

RANDOM.TITLE: Random button
RANDOM.DESCRIPTION: If this is your first time, use Random to automatically generate a deck and start faster.

CLEAR.TITLE: Clear button
CLEAR.DESCRIPTION: Clear removes all selected cards from the current deck, letting you start over.

SAVE.TITLE: Save button
SAVE.DESCRIPTION: Save confirms the deck, but only when it follows the rules: 60 cards, at least one Basic Pokemon, and the copy limits.

ADD_CARD.TITLE: Add a card
ADD_CARD.DESCRIPTION: Tap the highlighted card to add it to the deck before continuing.
ADD_CARD.REQUIRED: First select a card to add to the deck.
ADD_CARD.NO_CARDS: There are no cards available to add. Try clearing the filters to find a card.

CARD_LIBRARY.TITLE: Card library
CARD_LIBRARY.DESCRIPTION: Here you can see all available cards. Choose cards from this library to add them to your deck.

SEARCH.TITLE: Search bar
SEARCH.DESCRIPTION: Use the search bar to find cards by name.

FILTERS.TITLE: Type filters
FILTERS.DESCRIPTION: These filters let you switch between all cards, Pokemon, Energy, and Trainer cards.

SELECTED_LIST.TITLE: Selected cards
SELECTED_LIST.DESCRIPTION: On the right, you can see every card currently added to your deck and manage its quantity.

RULES.TITLE: Deck rules
RULES.DESCRIPTION: These indicators show whether your deck follows the rules: 60 cards, copy limits, and at least one Basic Pokemon.

COUNT.TITLE: Card count
COUNT.DESCRIPTION: This indicator helps you track how many cards are currently in the deck.

QUANTITY.TITLE: Plus and minus
QUANTITY.DESCRIPTION: Use plus and minus to add or remove copies of a card while respecting the deck limits.

TYPE_HIGHLIGHT.TITLE: Type highlight
TYPE_HIGHLIGHT.DESCRIPTION: Cards have visual highlights based on their type, helping you recognize Pokemon, Energy, and Trainer cards faster.

ADD_CARD.TITLE: Add a card
ADD_CARD.DESCRIPTION: Tap a card to add it to the deck. On mobile there is no fixed list on the side: quantity is managed from a separate panel.

OPEN_PANEL.TITLE: Open the deck panel
OPEN_PANEL.DESCRIPTION: Tap this button to open the panel where you manage the quantity of the card you just added.

QUANTITY.TITLE: Add or remove copies
QUANTITY.DESCRIPTION: Inside the panel, use plus to add copies (this confirms the addition) and minus to remove them.

CURRENT_DECK.TITLE: Cards added
CURRENT_DECK.DESCRIPTION: This same panel shows every card already added to the deck. You can check it anytime by tapping the button below.

INTRO.TITLE: Pokedex
INTRO.DESCRIPTION: This is the Pokedex. Here you can browse every available card and understand what it does before building or editing a deck.

CARD_IMAGE.TITLE: Card image
CARD_IMAGE.DESCRIPTION: This area shows the currently selected card so you can quickly recognize it and inspect its visual details.

CARD_INFO.TITLE: Card details
CARD_INFO.DESCRIPTION: This panel shows category, subtype, evolution data, type, retreat cost, weaknesses, resistances, attacks, and abilities when they apply.

EMPTY_DATA.TITLE: Missing information
EMPTY_DATA.DESCRIPTION: Some cards do not have every field. When a value does not apply or is unavailable, the page shows Not applicable or No data.

ATTACKS.TITLE: Attacks and abilities
ATTACKS.DESCRIPTION: This area shows attack costs, names, damage, effects, and any abilities available in the card information. The page clearly indicates when none are available.

SEARCH.TITLE: Search
SEARCH.DESCRIPTION: Use this input to search cards by name. You can try typing now or continue the tutorial.

FILTERS.TITLE: Filters
FILTERS.DESCRIPTION: Use these filters to show all cards, only Pokemon, only Energy cards, or only Trainer cards. You can try them now.

CARD_LIST.TITLE: Card list
CARD_LIST.DESCRIPTION: This list contains every card matching the current search and filter. You can browse it without leaving the tutorial.

SELECT_CARD.TITLE: Select a card
SELECT_CARD.DESCRIPTION: Click any card in the list to update the main image and details. You can try it now and then continue the tutorial.

FINISH.TITLE: Done
FINISH.DESCRIPTION: You can now search, filter, select cards, and review their full information in the Pokedex.

CARD_GRID.TITLE: Card grid
CARD_GRID.DESCRIPTION: Below you have the grid with every card matching the search and filter. On mobile there is no fixed detail panel: tap a card to open it.

OPEN_CARD.TITLE: Open a card
OPEN_CARD.DESCRIPTION: Tap a card in the grid to see its full information.

CARD_MODAL.TITLE: Card detail
CARD_MODAL.DESCRIPTION: On mobile, the full information is shown in this panel: category, type, attacks, and more.

CLOSE_MODAL.TITLE: Close the detail
CLOSE_MODAL.DESCRIPTION: Tap the X or the dark backdrop to close this panel and go back to the card grid.

WELCOME.TITLE: Trainer profile
WELCOME.DESCRIPTION: This is your profile page: account details, password settings, and match history in one place.

TRAINER_DATA.TITLE: Trainer details
TRAINER_DATA.DESCRIPTION: This section shows your username, verified email, and the option to change your password.

AVATAR.TITLE: Trainer avatar
AVATAR.DESCRIPTION: You can change your avatar by clicking it. This is optional: try it now or press Continue to keep going.

USERNAME.TITLE: Username
USERNAME.DESCRIPTION: Here you can see the trainer name other players will recognize when you play.

EDIT_USERNAME.TITLE: Edit username
EDIT_USERNAME.DESCRIPTION: Click the pencil button to enter edit mode. The tutorial continues when the save and cancel controls appear.

SAVE_CANCEL_USERNAME.TITLE: Save or cancel
SAVE_CANCEL_USERNAME.DESCRIPTION: While editing, the check button saves the new username and the X button cancels the change.

EMAIL_VERIFIED.TITLE: Verified email
EMAIL_VERIFIED.DESCRIPTION: This area shows your email address and the badge confirming that your account is verified.

CHANGE_PASSWORD.TITLE: Change password
CHANGE_PASSWORD.DESCRIPTION: This button starts the password change flow, but the tutorial only explains it. No panel is opened and no verification code is sent.

PASSWORD_CODE.TITLE: Verification code
PASSWORD_CODE.DESCRIPTION: The email code is valid for 5 minutes and can be resent after 60 seconds. A valid code is required before choosing a new password.

OPEN_HISTORY.TITLE: Open match history
OPEN_HISTORY.DESCRIPTION: Click Match history to continue. The tutorial waits for the real tab interaction before changing sections.

HISTORY_OVERVIEW.TITLE: Match history
HISTORY_OVERVIEW.DESCRIPTION: This section summarizes played matches, wins, losses, win rate, and your current streak.

TOTAL_GAMES.TITLE: Played matches
TOTAL_GAMES.DESCRIPTION: This number shows how many matches you have played in total.

WINS_LOSSES.TITLE: Wins and losses
WINS_LOSSES.DESCRIPTION: Here you can see how many matches you won and how many you lost.

WINS.TITLE: Wins
WINS.DESCRIPTION: Here you can see how many matches you have won.

LOSSES.TITLE: Losses
LOSSES.DESCRIPTION: Here you can see your losses. Losing also helps you understand what to improve.

WIN_RATE.TITLE: Win rate
WIN_RATE.DESCRIPTION: The win rate compares your wins against your total played matches.

CURRENT_STREAK.TITLE: Current streak
CURRENT_STREAK.DESCRIPTION: The current streak shows how many matches in a row you have won.

HISTORY_FILTERS.TITLE: History filters
HISTORY_FILTERS.DESCRIPTION: Use these filters to show all matches, wins, losses, the last 7 days, or the last 30 days.

MATCH_LIST.TITLE: Match list
MATCH_LIST.DESCRIPTION: This area shows each played match and its result. If you have not played yet, it displays the existing empty state.

FINISH.TITLE: Profile ready
FINISH.DESCRIPTION: You now know where to manage your account security and review your match history.
